text:
omar: Heads up — p99 spiking on dedicated-usw1-s2, looks like a single tenant hammering NIC egress + kvcache thrash. anyone oncall to triage?

sylvie: can you paste the metrics and host id?

omar: quick snippet:
```
slice=dedicated-usw1-s2
host=rack-2-host4
nic_tx_tail_mbps=1350
kvcache_miss_rate=0.29
request_latency_p99=220ms
```

kevin: short ops playbook: toggle tenant prefetch=false, evict best-effort batch pods, and apply nic_shaper 25% on rack-2-host4. avoid full cordon because we have reserved commitments.

ops-bot: actions applied by @kevin at 2025-03-10T03:12Z: prefetch_toggle tenant=off; evicted pods=12; nic_shaper=25%. monitoring p99 & kvcache every 30s.

sylvie: after actions p99 fell to ~110ms and kvcache_miss down to 0.08. nice. long-term we should add an automated "noise-fingerprint" detector: condition kv_miss>0.2 && nic_tx_tail>1000 over 10m -> simulate fractional carve for 48h -> canary assign (10% us-west1) if cost delta acceptable. also emit metric fingerprint_hits and per-tenant noise_counter.

kevin: +1. run a 48h sim on top-10 noisy tenants and gate billing flags behind human review. i'll own the canary rollout.

omar: i'll monitor slice for 2h and open a cost-sim PR for finance. tagging @finance @product for visibility.
